title: SPOTting the Future: Lookahead Explanations for Deep Reinforcement Learning
description:
arXiv:2608.09967v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) agents achieve strong performance in complex environments, yet their decision-making processes remain difficult to interpret. We introduce SPOT (Sampling Policy Observation Tree), a novel model-agnostic, sampling-based framework for interpreting DRL policies.
